description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AcceptOffer" name="Offer accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DenyOffer" name="Offer denied"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentStatusUpdate" name="Status update about internship"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate" name="Status update about student"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AcceptOffer" name="Offer accepted" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DenyOffer" name="Offer denied" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentStatus" name="Status update" sourceRef="Task_WriteStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Message_StudentStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyStatus" name="Status update about student" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Internship (Student)" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Search started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProfile" name="Enter topic, desired salary, experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Offer to review"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferReceived" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewOffer" name="Review offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer"/>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_InvalidOffers">
      <bpmn:text>As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipSplit" name="Start internship activities"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WeekPassed" name="One week passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_WeekPassed">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteStatusUpdate" name="Write status update about internship"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentUpdateCheck" name="At least 3 status updates written?"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyUpdateMerge" name="Wait for company update"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate" name="Company status update received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyStatusUpdate" messageRef="Message_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyUpdateCheck" name="At least 3 company updates received?"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipJoin" name="Internship finished"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecommendCompany" name="Recommend company to list of friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send tweet to each friend" messageRef="Message_Tweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Done" name="Recommendations sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_EnterProfile"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Profile" sourceRef="Task_EnterProfile" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToReview" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Task_ReviewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReviewOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny" name="Denied" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyLoop" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptToInternship" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToWeek" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="Event_WeekPassed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompanyMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyUpdateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WeekToWrite" sourceRef="Event_WeekPassed" targetRef="Task_WriteStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToCheck" sourceRef="Task_WriteStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_StudentUpdateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentMoreUpdates" name="Fewer than 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentUpdateCheck" targetRef="Event_WeekPassed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${statusUpdatesWritten < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentDone" name="3 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentUpdateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${statusUpdatesWritten >= 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyMergeToWait" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyUpdateMerge" targetRef="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyToCheck" sourceRef="Event_CompanyStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyUpdateCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyMoreUpdates" name="Fewer than 3" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyUpdateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyUpdateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyStatusUpdatesReceived < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyDone" name="3 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyUpdateCheck" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyStatusUpdatesReceived >= 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToRecommend" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin" targetRef="Task_RecommendCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecommendToTweets" sourceRef="Task_RecommendCompany" targetRef="Task_SendTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="EndEvent_Done"/>

    <bpmn:association id="Association_InvalidOffers" sourceRef="Annotation_InvalidOffers" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
